verses.pali: Yasmiṁ, bhikkhave, samaye ariyasāvako aṭṭhiṁ katvā manasi katvā sabbaṁ cetaso samannāharitvā ohitasoto dhammaṁ suṇāti, imassa pañca nīvaraṇā tasmiṁ samaye na honti. Satta bojjhaṅgā tasmiṁ samaye bhāvanāpāripūriṁ gacchanti.
verses.english: “Mendicants, sometimes a noble disciple pays attention, applies the mind, concentrates wholeheartedly, and actively listens to the teaching. At such a time the five hindrances are absent, and the seven awakening factors are fully developed.

verses.pali: Katame pañca nīvaraṇā tasmiṁ samaye na honti?
verses.english: What are the five hindrances that are absent?

verses.pali: Kāmacchandanīvaraṇaṁ tasmiṁ samaye na hoti, byāpādanīvaraṇaṁ tasmiṁ samaye na hoti, thinamiddhanīvaraṇaṁ tasmiṁ samaye na hoti, uddhaccakukkuccanīvaraṇaṁ tasmiṁ samaye na hoti, vicikicchānīvaraṇaṁ tasmiṁ samaye na hoti.
verses.english: Sensual desire, ill will, dullness and drowsiness, restlessness and remorse, and doubt.

verses.pali: Imassa pañca nīvaraṇā tasmiṁ samaye na honti.
verses.english: These are the five hindrances that are absent.

verses.pali: Katame satta bojjhaṅgā tasmiṁ samaye bhāvanāpāripūriṁ gacchanti?
verses.english: And what are the seven awakening factors that are fully developed?

verses.pali: Satisambojjhaṅgo tasmiṁ samaye bhāvanāpāripūriṁ gacchati …pe… upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo tasmiṁ samaye bhāvanāpāripūriṁ gacchati.
verses.english: The awakening factors of mindfulness, investigation of principles, energy, rapture, tranquility, immersion, and equanimity.

verses.pali: Ime satta bojjhaṅgā tasmiṁ samaye bhāvanāpāripūriṁ gacchanti.
verses.english: These are the seven awakening factors that are fully developed.

verses.pali: Yasmiṁ, bhikkhave, samaye ariyasāvako aṭṭhiṁ katvā manasi katvā sabbaṁ cetaso samannāharitvā ohitasoto dhammaṁ suṇāti, imassa pañca nīvaraṇā tasmiṁ samaye na honti. Ime satta bojjhaṅgā tasmiṁ samaye bhāvanāpāripūriṁ gacchantī”ti.
verses.english: Sometimes a noble disciple pays attention, applies the mind, concentrates wholeheartedly, and actively listens to the teaching. At such a time the five hindrances are absent, and the seven awakening factors are fully developed.”
